resources.string: On-device LiteRT-LM — download Gemma .litertlm in Models (multi‑GB).
First reply after picking a model may take a while while the engine loads.

Run Ollama where your network can reach it. Tap the + button to add a name and base URL (for example http://192.168.1.10:11434). Set a server as default from its card, then tap Back to open your chats.
Tap \"%1$s\" in the top toolbar, then open Models to download an on-device model. Set a server as default on its card if needed, then use Back to return to chats.
